messages:
omar: FYI ran the nightly shadow eval for Lighthouse's LoRA+int4 bundle. Seeing a spike in id-extraction failures for billing. not noise.

mira: link?

omar: https://internal.redwood/evals/shadow/ldg-1802. Summary: overall pass rate stable but "invoice_id" exact-match drops ~15% with int4+kv-pack. embedding similarity for invoice headers also down ~0.08 cosine.

jess: wow. can you paste an example?

omar: sanitized snippet: ```
input: "Invoice ID: INV-00987X, subtotal $2342.00"
gold: "INV-00987X"
fp16: "INV-00987X"
int4+kv: "INV-00987"
```

mira: interesting it's dropping the final character on many alphanumeric IDs. suggests a boundary/tokenization offset rather than a surface LM failure.

ml-bot: quick-stats: invoice_id_exact: 0.93 -> 0.78, header_embed_cosine: 0.89 -> 0.81, avg_seq_len_delta: -0.06

jess: is this reproducible without KV packing? can we try int4 with kv disabled?

omar: scheduled a compare run: `rundev shadow-compare --customer lighthouse --bundle 2026-03-22 --variants fp16 int4-no-kv int4-kvfast --save /tmp/lgh-1802-compare` (running now). ETA ~10m.

mira: I'll also dump token ids + kv offsets for one failing case and diff. command: `rundev trace-kv --run /tmp/lgh-1802-compare --example 134 --out /tmp/kv-trace-134`

ops-sam: if kv_pack is the vector, we should block any autopromote that turns it on for customer bundles. can we toggle a per-customer feature flag quickly?

jess: yes we have `routing.features.kv_pack` override per-customer. I'll stage a flag to force kv_pack=false for Lighthouse and add it to the canary blocklist.

mira: run finished. preliminary: fp16=0.93, int4-no-kv=0.92, int4-kvfast=0.78. same pattern. KV traces show final token's kv_index shifted by -1 in packed layout for failing cases. saving diffs to /tmp/kv-diffs-134.txt

omar: that lines up with token-level logprobs: fp16/int4-no-kv both assign high prob to final char token; int4-kvfast has a low prob and model emits EOS early. maybe KV read at decode step pulling wrong context vector.

ml-bot: ticket created: ML-3820 "Lighthouse int4 kv-pack token boundary regression". linked runs and traces.

ops-sam: holding canary. I'll message Lighthouse PM with a short note.

jess: action items: mira -> KV pack trace + minimal repro and unit test; omar -> write token-logprob diff tool for quick triage; jess -> apply per-customer kv_pack=false override and add regression to CI smoke; ops-sam -> confirm canary hold to infra. target: revert default kv_pack for int4 until fix or add a safety-check on trace mismatches.

omar: one potential mitigation: if final token prob < threshold, force no-kv path at decode-time. might be cheaper quick fix than toggling routing. I'll prototype an inline guard.

mira: putting trace PR together now. will include the failing example list and exact tokenids.

jess: thanks. ping here when override is live and when ML-3820 gets a PR.

ml-bot: note: linked PRs: none yet. jobs: shadow-compare/1802.1 completed.

ops-sam: ack. blocking canary and notifying customer.

jess: thanks all. let's keep chatter in this thread for updates. :eyes:
